---
title: "Interactive widget"
description: "Any vellumplot becomes a client-side interactive widget with as_widget(): hover, select, brush, and zoom."
categories: [Interactive]
image: figs/interactive.png
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
library(vellumwidget)
# A static preview for the gallery card.
prev <- vplot(data.frame(wt = mtcars$wt, mpg = mtcars$mpg)) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, size = 2.2, color = "#6b4f2c")
render_plot(prev, "figs/interactive.png", dpi = 150)
```

Pipe any vellumplot into `as_widget()` and it becomes a self-contained HTML
widget: hover a point for a tooltip, click to select, drag a rectangle to brush,
scroll to zoom. It runs entirely in the browser, with no server.

Declare `tooltip` and `data_id` on the mark to give each point a label and a
stable key for interactions.

```{r}
df <- data.frame(wt = mtcars$wt, mpg = mtcars$mpg, model = rownames(mtcars))

vplot(df) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, tooltip = model, data_id = model) |>
  as_widget()
```

Map colour to a discrete variable and you get an interactive legend: hover a
swatch to highlight its series, click to select it.

```{r}
df$cyl <- factor(mtcars$cyl)

vplot(df) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = cyl, tooltip = model, data_id = model) |>
  as_widget()
```
